description: The municipality of Bari publishes school inventories and annual school lists. Annual school/institution lists are grouped with three native school-map or school-list publications. The named school years run from 2016/2017 to 2025/2026, with 2022/2023 absent from this saved inventory. Maps and annual tables are separate representations of the municipal school inventory; equivalence of individual sites and rows is unverified. School capacity, structural condition and accessibility are not described. Coverage is Bari, Italy. The group retains 12 separately identified native publications. The provider lists CSV, JSON, XLS, XLSX, ZIP representations. Archive contents and data rows were not read. The native catalogue declares a Creative Commons Attribution licence without a version; file-use charges and download conditions are not established. Metadata timestamps do not prove observation dates or present operation. Accuracy, completeness and current availability of individual features remain unverified. No specific simulation use is assigned. Related publications are linked through their exact metadata records; shared hosting alone does not establish equivalence.
